descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B23 · P1 · 已知

病人卡片缺字段：年龄是「76y」不是「76F」，医院卡片没有住院天数，养老院卡片没有访视次数

票：TFA-92579 AC3–4 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S03, TC-01/S05, TC-01/S26

思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S06 「养老院就诊次数随入院时长和就诊次数一直往上涨，超过「最近两次就诊」窗口也是」 Nursing Home visit number keeps rising with admission age and visits, including past the 'last two visits' window

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U6 The day/visit number advances each calendar day by server time and never stays frozen; a device with a wrong clock or time zone shows the same number.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 4；UAT 3.8）
  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-01；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given seededCensus N1 (admitted today, 0 prior visits), N3 (−3 d, 1 prior), N4 (−7 d, 2 prior), N5 (−14 d, 4 prior on distinct days; 3.6 keeps only the last two)

When Read each resident's visit number on the card (Today's Visits and All Residents)

Then N1 shows the first value; N1 < N3 < N4 < N5; N5 is above N4 even though only two of its visits are retained

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Q3-independent: N1 = the first value ('Visit 1' format per Q3) and strictly N1 < N3 < N4 < N5. A number counted from retained visits caps at 3 under 3.6 and fails N5 > N4; a frozen number fails the ordering. The comparison needs numbers read per card, so it lives in the card-scoped spec (S26); oracle.mjs only matches substrings. …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92579 ready for qa

养老院住户卡片上完全没有访视次数，第五次访视的住户和今天刚入住的看起来一样。

Nursing Home resident cards show no visit number at all, so a resident on a fifth visit looks the same as one admitted today.

依据：newspec-a lane (N1/N3/N4/N5 seeded) plus the datasets lane. This is the visit-number half of dev report §2 #5 (C2, 'no hospital day / visit number', U27). The format is still open (Q3), but it does not matter because no number is shown.

并进来的：本地 datasets TC-01/S06 (same failure, folded into this result)

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-a。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S06

Nursing Home visit number keeps rising with admission age and visits, including past the 'last two visits' window

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Seed N1/N3/N4/N5 (and the S26 residents) on a fresh account with admitDate / addedAt back-dated and prior visits as snfVisitDates + previousNotes on distinct past server days (rows written through snf:add, the app's own mutation); open Today's Visits and All Residents, read each card's visit number (card-scoped). Oracle: a number is shown, N1 is the first value, strictly N1 < N3 < N4 < N5 (Q3-independent). — Seeding through snf:add accepts the visit-history fields; reading cards is a scripted browser step.

Detail:

N1 (admitted today, 0 prior), N3 (1 prior), N4 (2 prior), N5 (4 prior on distinct days) seeded on a fresh account; on Today's Visits and All Residents no card shows any visit number (no 'Visit N', 'Day N' or similar), so N1 < N3 < N4 < N5 cannot hold under either Q3 reading.

产品问题：A physician looking at the Nursing Home list sees no visit number on any resident card (cards show unit, age, stored diagnosis, status and admission badge only), so a resident on their 5th visit looks the same as one admitted today. Breaks UAT TC-01 Expected Result: 'the hospital day or visit number. The day/visit number advances each calendar day and must not stay frozen' (TFA-92579 AC 3/4).

证据：附了 4 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): it would seed prior visits and read the cards through the local admin helpers (backend.ts, fresh @roundai.test accounts); dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

这个用例别处也有结果（一个用例只显示一个：有结论的优先于卡住，跑过的优先于跳过；同一档取较差的，一样差取先的（dev、dev 的 lane、本地 lane A/C、本地新 lane），测试过时排在通过前面；都是跳过时取 dev 的，除非 dev 只说「本地专用 / dev 上跑不了」或和 lane 同一个原因）：

  • [dev datasets] 失败（datasets/results.json） — datasets: failed → 失败（失败（lane 没标产品问题）） today: every card shows a visit number (U5) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null} | today: n1 < n3 < n4 < n5 (U6) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null} | all: every card shows a visit number (U5) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null} | all: n1 < n3 < n4 < n5 (U6) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null}
  • [本地 datasets] 失败（datasets/results.json） — datasets: failed → 失败（失败（lane 没标产品问题）） today: every card shows a visit number (U5) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null} | today: n1 < n3 < n4 < n5 (U6) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null} | all: every card shows a visit number (U5) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null} | all: n1 < n3 < n4 < n5 (U6) → {"n1":null,"n3":null,"n4":null,"n5":null}
